title: Azure SQL and EF Core
description: Use Azure SQL Database with EF Core and C# in ASP.NET Core applications.
longDescription: Most ASP.NET Core apps need a relational database. This module teaches how to create Azure SQL Database servers and databases, connect from C#, configure EF Core for Azure SQL, and make database access resilient with retry policies.
whatYouLearn: Provision Azure SQL Database from C# and the Azure portal
Connect to Azure SQL securely from ASP.NET Core
Configure EF Core for Azure SQL and migrations
Add retry logic for transient database failures
